objectives: “Understanding the theory behind the operation of microwave circuits, and having the ability to design and analysis microwave passive circuits with the aid of modern CAD tools.“
content:
1. Introduction to microwave engineering
2. Transmission line theory
3. Transmission lines and waveguides
4. Microwave network analysis
5. Impedance matching and tuning
6. Microwave resonators
7. Power dividers and directional couplers
8. Microwave filters and slow-wave structures
books: “David. M. Pozar, “Microwave Engineering,” 4th Edition, John Wiley ＆ Sons, Inc., 2011.“
